description: 구조 분석: click 새 run

Click 화학 상호작용 작업 열기; choose the prepared receptor PDB and the pose SDF (file chooser), model 1, SDF record 0, ligand instance Z 901 LQA, the four acknowledgements and the terminal extensions, pH note; 준비 조건 미리보기 → 화학 구조 준비 작업 저장 → 준비 작업 시작 with the run's first expensive approval (이 실제 작업 승인): the real ProLIF preparation finishes and uses exactly one unit

receptor.name: prolif-vina-rec.pdb
receptor.provenance: public ProLIF tutorial prepared receptor (prepared docking example; not experimental validation)

sdf.name: prolif-vina-output.sdf
sdf.provenance: public ProLIF tutorial docking-pose SDF (prepared docking example; not experimental validation)

description: Rail models: 저장된 실제 준비 선택 → 상호작용 계산 작업 저장 → 상호작용 작업 시작 (no second approval): the real ProLIF detection finishes with rows and uses exactly one unit

Read every stored interaction row: each role atom is an atom of the input files (receptor: residue fields, atom name, element and coordinates of the PDB; ligand: element and coordinates of SDF record 0) and each D···A distance (and D–H···A angle when stored) equals the one recomputed from the input coordinates; the first page on screen lists the same rows
Click the first interaction row: the viewer focuses exactly that row's role atoms and shows the stored distance (and angle) (adapted from chemical-flow.cjs focusFirstRow)
Click 화학 보고서 저장: saved (201); Markdown and 정확한 JSON 다운로드 equal the backend bytes; every row claim (distance, angle) equals the stored row
리간드 설계·탐색: choose the public-derived parent SDF, the labeled synthetic block SDF and SMILES files (file chooser), type rules 2 and 3 of the synthetic rule file (two lines), click 가져오기
Click 점검 시작 (approval if asked) → 작업 시작: the real RDKit inspection finishes with one unit; both typed rules are valid; the block libraries count the input files' records
Tick parent atom 22 (the site check passes), keep 고정 교체 on, tick user_1 and user_2; click 후보 생성 시작: the real RDKit enumeration finishes with one unit

Click the new candidate set: at least 5 candidates; the table equals the server rows; ids are c_ + SHA-256(SMILES)[:16]; every property column says RDKit 추정값 and the PAINS column 구조 경고 일치; no drug-likeness, toxicity, activity or synthesizability word outside the stored limitation sentences
Type 중원자 수 최댓값 = the median stored value and click 필터 적용: the server applies it to the stored values (each row's pass equals heavy_atoms ≤ bound computed here); clear it
Click ⑥ 보고서 만들기 for the set: saved (201), analysis_type ligand_candidates

Docking area: choose the prepared receptor PDB (file chooser), 가져오기; 입력 목록 다시 읽기; receptor, model 1, 없음, PDB CONECT, M17 후보 + 부모 3D SDF (the set, its first candidate, the parent SDF), 자유 도킹, 직접 입력 box (3.41, 0.72, 11.31) 12 Å, seed 1, exhaustiveness 1, num_modes 2, energy_range 3, the three acknowledgements; 도킹 작업 시작: the real qvina job finishes with one unit (no second approval)
Click the result: the score is the qvina 점수 label, rows are 모드 n(엔진 출력 순서), the mode table and limitations equal the stored result; the inputs are this plan's values and file

Click 접촉 보기 of 모드 1: the contact page equals the stored contacts (geometric contacts by distance only, the area's own note says so); every stored contact equals one pair recomputed here from the input receptor PDB and the stored pose (heavy atoms, ≤ 4.0 Å, element-pair kind)
Click 모드 1 내려받기: bytes equal the stored pose_sdf and the backend bytes
Click 포즈 SDF 전체 내려받기: bytes equal the stored pose_sdf and the backend bytes
The same arguments again: click 도킹 작업 시작 with the form unchanged: the existing job is shown again (같은 입력의 기존 작업 …, no new job), no unit is used
Click 보고서 만들기 for the result: saved (201), analysis_type ligand_docking

지식·보고서 JEV area: switch the run's science consent on; 리간드 후보 집합 and the set; check its first three candidates; 보낼 내용 만들기; open the exact body: its text = the server preview string, its SHA-256 and bytes computed here = shown = the stored projection

Check the confirmation and click 이 내용을 JEV로 보냅니다 (fixture good): completed; the card is the stored proposal, labeled JEV 판정(모델 선택); the bytes the transport received = the preview = the prepared audit; the M24 wording check of the area finds nothing
보고서 만들기 on the send row: saved (201); the library shows JEV 판정 보고서 with the stored Markdown (fixed sentences, no per-candidate values, no forbidden word)

JEV 루프 (리간드): choose the set, check the pool (3), 탐색형, loop seed 31, cap 1, the computation inputs (the docking values of B3); 루프 만들기: computed candidates are scored as stored (reused, no unit), the others pending

보낼 내용 만들기 (consent on): the exact body = the server preview = the SHA-256 computed here = the stored projection; the order, aliases, criteria and computed rows = the independent sha256_order_v1 oracle; the body carries no score (explore)

Check the confirmation and click 이 내용을 JEV로 보냅니다 (fixture good): the result as stored; a completed send shows the selection card JEV 판정(모델 선택) = the stored jev_loop_choice@1 (list position n/m as a value only)

Check the compute confirmation and press 이 선택으로 계산 시작 (JEV 판정 사용): one unit; the standalone M18 job (real qvina) on the candidate the card named; the round ends with the stored first-mode score; the cap ends the loop's iterations
루프 끝내기: the summary jev_loop_result@1 is stored (scores = stored first modes); the sentences add LJ8 (candidates left without a score, not 0); 보고서 만들기: saved (201), JEV 루프 보고서 in the library

JEV 루프 (리간드): choose the set, check the pool (4), 활용형, loop seed 37, cap 1, the computation inputs (the docking values of B3); 루프 만들기: computed candidates are scored as stored (reused, no unit), the others pending

보낼 내용 만들기 (consent on): the exact body = the server preview = the SHA-256 computed here = the stored projection; the order, aliases, criteria and computed rows = the independent sha256_order_v1 oracle; the computed rows carry the stored first-mode scores (exploit)

Check the confirmation and click 이 내용을 JEV로 보냅니다 (fixture good_second): the result as stored; a completed send shows the selection card JEV 판정(모델 선택) = the stored jev_loop_choice@1 (list position n/m as a value only)

Check the compute confirmation and press 이 선택으로 계산 시작 (JEV 판정 사용): one unit; the standalone M18 job (real qvina) on the candidate the card named; the round ends with the stored first-mode score; the cap ends the loop's iterations
루프 끝내기: the summary jev_loop_result@1 is stored (scores = stored first modes); the sentences add LJ8 (candidates left without a score, not 0); 보고서 만들기: saved (201), JEV 루프 보고서 in the library

일괄 도킹: 입력 목록 다시 읽기; the receptor (model 1, 없음, PDB CONECT), the set and its parent SDF; tick 4 candidates (3 with a stored result of these values, 1 without), 부모 기준 행, 자유 도킹 with the B3 values; 시작 전 확인 보기: 2 new rows, 3 reused, the shortfall is the plan's
Click 이 일괄에 필요한 만큼 한도를 올림 (a person's click): the limit rises by the shortfall only, by human; the preflight is read again with no shortfall

Click 일괄 시작 (no second approval): the real qvina batch runs to done with the plan's units; choose its summary: every row (state, score = its M18 first mode, 모드 1(엔진 출력 순서), reuse mark) equals the stored summary; B1 and B3 verbatim; the headers are the M19 ones
Click 점수, 후보 id and 행 번호 headers twice each: the order follows the independent sort rule (rows without a score always last), aria-sort follows
Click 상세 열기 of every row: the M18 docking area opens that row's stored result and its 모드 1 score cell equals the row's score cell; each row score is the first mode of that single M18 result
Click 보고서 만들기 for the batch summary: saved (201), analysis_type ligand_docking_batch

GA area: 입력 목록 다시 읽기; the set and its parent, the receptor (model 1, 없음, PDB CONECT), the B3 docking values, the acknowledgements; setting 1 (seed 11, population_size 4, generations 2, elite_count 2, tournament_size 2, neighbor_count 3, random_fraction 0.2, patience 3, max_new_dockings 6, total_s 600); 시작 전 확인 보기: the reserved units are on screen and equal the spec 6 arithmetic

lines.재사용 가능: 저장된 결과 재사용 가능 후보 4개 (과금하지 않음, 새 도킹 상한에 세지 않음)
lines.과금: 시작하면 6단위가 예약·소진되고 중간에 멈추거나 재사용이 있어도 돌려받지 않음
lines.시간 상한: 끝까지 못 갈 수 있음: 예약 단위 × 300초가 GA 전체 시간 상한보다 깁니다. 시간 상한에 닿으면 그때까지 평가한 개체만 남습니다.
lines.대기: GA가 도는 동안 이 run의 다른 계산·보고서 호출과 다른 비싼 작업이 기다립니다.

capability.score_label: qvina 점수(kcal/mol, Vina 계열 스코어링 함수 값. 친화도가 아님)

statements.G1: GA는 후보 풀에서 어디를 도킹할지 정하는 탐색 방법이며, 개체의 점수 정렬·선택 표시는 순위나 추천이 아니다. 부모·유사 후보 연결은 작업 모듈 기록이며 서버가 다시 계산하지 않았다.
statements.G2: 이 실행은 시간·도킹 상한·취소 등으로 일부 세대만 계산되었다. 계산하지 않은 개체는 점수가 없으며 0이 아니고, 한도 도달로 멈춘 실행은 같은 설정으로 다시 해도 같은 경로를 보장하지 않는다.
statements.G3: 재사용한 개체는 같은 수용체·상자·seed·방식·값으로 이전에 저장된 도킹 결과를 가져온 것이며, 저장된 결과 집합이 다르면 같은 GA seed도 다른 경로를 낼 수 있다.
